title: Exchange Rates
description: SwiftCargo prices shipments in USD but bills in whatever currency the customer picks. Generate an invoice in JPY (which has no decimal places) and confirm the amount is a whole number, not rounded like a 2-decimal currency.
successCondition: POST /api/billing/shipments/:shipmentId/invoice with { "currency": "JPY" } returns 201 with an invoice whose amountCents is a whole number representing yen (no fractional minor unit), while the same call with { "currency": "EUR" } produces a 2-decimal amount — prove the two aren't rounded the same way.
hints: Book a shipment first (or use a seeded one) to get a shipment id.
Supported currencies and rounding rules are documented in docs/api/billing.md.
